title: Protect the Rock Shell
description: A ball handler dribbles inside a tight shell formed by teammates' arms, learning to protect the ball from constant light pressure on all sides.

content.objective: Keep the ball alive under constant, close defensive pressure from more than one side.
content.setup: One ball handler stands in the middle of three or four teammates forming a tight circle around them.
instructions: The ball handler dribbles in place, pivoting to keep the ball away from whoever is closest.
The surrounding players reach and poke at the ball without grabbing or fouling hard.
Rotate the ball handler every 20 seconds.
Add a dribble-out: the ball handler must dribble out of the circle to end their turn successfully.
coachingPoints: Keep the ball on the side away from the nearest defender.
Use the forearm and body, not just the dribbling hand, to shield.
Pivot the body to change which side is exposed.
commonMistakes: Picking up the dribble out of panic.
Keeping the ball in the same spot instead of moving it side to side.
Watching the ball instead of keeping the head up.
content.safety: Reach for the ball only — no grabbing the arm or body.
